annotations.summary: {{ $labels.deployment_environment_name }} database is using over 80% of max_connections
annotations.description: The odb web dyno samples pg_stat_activity every minute into lucuma_db_connections_used (by application_name) and lucuma_db_connections_max. Once the limit is reached new connections are refused. Check which application_name grew on the GPP Service Status dashboard, and the *_MAX_CONNECTIONS config vars times dyno counts. No data means the sample itself failed, possibly because the database is already full: check the web dyno log for 'Database connection sample failed'.
